_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Images/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Images/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Rewritten 2026-10-20 (login-free first iteration, Docs_UNI_SIM/login-free-plan.md): opening, resizing, cropping, converting, reading and stripping metadata, blurring faces and removing backgrounds happen on the device and collect nothing (the face and background models are downloaded from public CDNs; no picture or user data goes with the request). No accounts (noAccounts in src/main.tsx, no sign-in, no <UsageTracker />), so the online backup that used to upload an edited picture is gone; the backup is a file the user keeps. No usage count: the suite user count (install id) was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0, and the anonymous daily open count that replaced it is off under noAccounts. Nothing is collected or shared. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
